data.title: 远坂凛 · 珠宝店
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 珠宝店】高档商业街珠宝专柜明亮的射灯下，凛正两眼发光地趴在展示柜玻璃前，极其认真地评估着一枚顶级未加工红宝石的魔力储量与净度——「这颗宝石的纯度和折射率简直无可挑剔！要是能用来刻印高阶诅咒……啊，价格竟然有这么多零？！」
data.action: 认真端详展示柜里的宝石
data.promptProse: Rin leans toward the jewelry display with both palms lightly on the glass edge, studying one uncut ruby on its dark cushion. Appraising aqua eyes brighten before a raised eyebrow questions the price. Her red turtleneck and black skirt fill the medium view, surrounding cases receding behind. The focused counter lamp lights the stone's rough facets and her fingers, with controlled reflections across the glass and deep shade beneath the cushion.
